welcome.friendCode: Did a friend send you a code?
welcome.guestNote: You're playing as a guest. Create your profile to keep your wins.

join.title: Join a room
join.lead: Type the code your friend sent you. No account to create.
join.unknown: Unknown code: check with your friend.
join.closed: This room is closed. Ask your friend for a new code.
join.offline: No network: the code is kept, we'll try again.
join.error: We couldn't look for the room.
join.fullHint: All seats are taken: you can watch instead.
join.playingHint: The game has already started: you can watch it.
join.guestNote: As a guest, you play without stakes and your wins aren't kept. At the end, you can create your profile to get them back.
join.memberNote: You join with your profile, under your username.

signup.title: Your Kwatt profile
signup.lead: One profile for every game in the hub.
signup.pseudoAvailable: Available · it's your name in every game
signup.pseudoBanned: This username isn't allowed. Pick another one.
signup.pseudoOffline: We'll check as soon as the network is back.
signup.consentA11y: I accept the neighbourhood rules and the privacy policy
signup.consentRequired: Accept the neighbourhood rules to continue.

hint.symbol: add a symbol to make it strong
hint.digit: add a digit to make it strong
hint.upper: add a capital letter to make it strong
hint.longer: make it longer to make it strong

age.title: Your year of birth
age.lead: It's never shown. It sets what you can do with your cowries.

rule.joinAsGuest: Join a room as a guest

age.playAsGuest: Play as a guest with a code
age.warning: A false year may lead to the account being closed. Cowries are never worth real money.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.lead: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.why: You can play right away. A verified address lets you stake and recover your account.

tutorial.step1Text: Checkers, Ludo, and soon reasoning. Each game has its own level, but your cowries, cards and friends follow you everywhere.
tutorial.step2Title: Your neighbourhood is counting on you
tutorial.step2Text: Every ranked win lifts your neighbourhood. Pick yours: you can change it once per season.
tutorial.step3Text: Start against the machine: it adapts to you from the very first moves. Your 500 welcome cowries are waiting.

quarter.label: Your neighbourhood
quarter.none: No results. Try the name of your city.
quarter.nextChange: You can change it again on {{date}}.
quarter.offline: No network: the list will be back with it.

signin.title: Welcome back
signin.waitRetry: Too many tries. Try again in {{time}}.
signin.deletionCancelled: Deletion cancelled: good to see you again!

forgot.contactText: Give your profile's email address: we'll send a 6-digit code there.
forgot.codeText: Sent by email to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
forgot.resent: If a profile uses this address, a new code is on its way.
forgot.newText: Your other devices will be signed out; this one stays signed in.
forgot.done: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.
forgot.codeInvalid: Wrong or expired code. Check it, or ask for a new code.
